Teacher Notes

Audio timing: the MP3 contains about 6.9 seconds of track/title prompts before the dialogue. The cue times in this version were recalibrated to the actual MP3; they are still labeled as approximate, and each sentence playback includes a small safety pre/post roll.

Pronunciation: the reference map is deliberately conservative. It does not mark every possible consonant connection or every written /t/ and /d/ as plosion. Use the embedded recording as the final classroom reference.

AI Retelling: the local quick check is only a lightweight classroom helper. The generated AI prompt asks for content, grammar, natural English, and signal use without rewriting the whole retelling.
